editorial: We did not keep a clean expense sheet for Colombia.

Our practical impression was that everyday meals and local life were manageable, while internal flights and tourism-heavy Cartagena pushed the budget upward. Cartagena also delivered the weakest value-for-money feeling because so many interactions around tourist areas felt monetised.

alternatives.title: What if we had a bigger budget?
editorial: We'd spend it on a carefully vetted Cartagena stay and perhaps a private boat day rather than improvising beach logistics on arrival. We'd also add the coffee region.

alternatives.title: What if we had a smaller budget?
editorial: Base the trip around Medellin and Guatape. That pair delivered our best Colombia experience without needing multiple domestic flights or expensive coastal excursions.
